top_signals.title: Amazon's Zoox to launch paid robotaxi service in Las Vegas on Aug. 10
top_signals.summary: It's the company's first commercial market after Zoox started offering free rides to the public in parts of Las Vegas and San Francisco less than a year ago.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
